note: The frozen half of OER-11. Nothing a submission says may move any number in this file. The verifier reads its own copy of it at grading time, and tests/Dockerfile refuses to build unless the two copies are byte-identical.

budget.note: FIXED in tokens, in forward and backward passes, and in optimizer steps. Every submission costs the same FLOPs and very nearly the same wall clock.

init.note: THE SEED IS FROZEN AND THE DRAW IS FROZEN WITH IT, which is the mechanism that makes this slot about scaling and not about luck. The harness draws ONE standard-normal tensor per parameter, from a generator seeded by this seed and by that parameter's own name, and every run in this task -- the shipped default, the private reference and the submission -- multiplies that SAME draw by its own per-role scale. Two initialisations therefore differ by their scales alone and never by which random numbers they happened to receive, so a measured difference between them is a fact about the scaling and not a resampling artifact.

optimizer.note: FROZEN, and tuned. This is deliberately a STRONG optimizer rather than a weak one: a weak optimizer would let a submission win by rescuing the run rather than by initialising it well, and the point of this slot is what the initialisation is worth once the optimizer is already good. AdamW normalises each coordinate by its own second moment, so it absorbs a great deal of what an initialisation scale does to gradient magnitudes. What it does NOT absorb is what the scales do to the function the untrained network computes -- the size of the residual stream, how much signal reaches the head, how sharp the output distribution starts -- and that is the axis this slot grades.

evaluation.metric: mean token-level cross-entropy in nats, lower is better
evaluation.note: The graded split is NOT in the agent image. environment/data/devset_slice.bin is a proxy cut from a different FineWeb training shard and is the agent's own yardstick; it is never the graded number.

data.format: FineWeb10B GPT-2 BPE. 1024-byte int32 header (magic 20240520, version 1, token count), then uint16 token ids.
data.train_slice_note: Exactly the 25165824 tokens the budget consumes, plus one for the shifted target.
